_about: Named challenges read from game memory (PamServerNamedChallengeEntity, vtable 0x141C7EC70, +0x80 -> data: +0x10 Sid, +0x58 stat code, +0x98 ContentId), read-only, 2026-11-12, Steam build. Dashes: all 22, the in-game count; the same 22 were loaded in two districts, so they appear to load city-wide. Billboards: only the ones loaded near the player in two scans, NOT the full list. Deliveries and grid nodes never appeared in a scan. ContentId is stable across a game restart (tested on Concrete Canyon). district is parsed from the stat code. Display names: all 22 dashes localized in game by mecmp (localized = the game text, name = the dash list spelling). See docs/DLL.md section 11. star_thresholds_cs: time limits for 1/2/3 stars in hundredths of a second, and cancel_after_cs (PamNamedChallengeData +0x18..+0x24, read live 2026-11-12). Dashes have no UnlockFlag and no generated progression flag; billboards have one (progression_flag). ap_index: the dash's position in the in-game dash list (0 = Birdman's Dash); the Archipelago location ids are 1330000 + 10 * ap_index + tier (0 finish, 1-3 stars), so never renumber it.
